description:
Cursor-paginated list of a user's current Midnight positions.

**Position type.** `type` is `lend` for positions with credit, `borrow` for positions with debt, or `collateral_only` for positions with no credit or debt but remaining collateral. Closed positions with no credit, no debt, and no remaining collateral are excluded.

**Performance fields.** `cost_basis` uses the average cost method and is returned as a WAD-scaled bigint string in loan-token units. `effective_rate_wad` is the unchanged WAD-scaled compounded IRR+ using a 365.25-day year; `effective_apr` is the simple annualized decimal fraction using a 365-day year, capped at `10`, and derived from persisted open lots. Analytics can be `null` when there is not enough attributable history.

**Filters.** `chain_ids` is required when `loan_assets` is provided. `collateral_assets` matches configured market collateral tokens across all chains unless `chain_ids` narrows the query; lowercase addresses are checksummed. Range filters exist on `created_at`, `credit`, `debt`, `cost_basis`, and `effective_rate_wad`. `effective_apr` has no filter or sort key. `active_only=true` excludes matured markets. `listed=true` keeps only positions on listed markets; `listed=false` keeps only positions on unlisted markets.

**Pagination.** Response envelope: `{ cursor, data }`. Positions are ordered newest-first by `created_at` by default.

**Cache.** `public, max-age=2, stale-while-revalidate=1`.

active_only.description: When true, keep only positions whose market has not matured yet.

chain_ids.description: Filter by chain ids. Supported chains: Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arc (5042), and Robinhood Chain (4663). Required when loan_assets is provided.

collateral_assets.description: Filter by configured market collateral token addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

cost_basis_gte.description: Filter for cost basis greater than or equal to this value.

cost_basis_lte.description: Filter for cost basis less than or equal to this value.

created_at_gte.description: Filter for position created_at greater than or equal to this unix timestamp.

created_at_lte.description: Filter for position created_at less than or equal to this unix timestamp.

credit_gte.description: Filter for credit greater than or equal to this value.

credit_lte.description: Filter for credit less than or equal to this value.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page response.

debt_gte.description: Filter for debt greater than or equal to this value.

debt_lte.description: Filter for debt less than or equal to this value.

effective_rate_wad_gte.description: Filter for compounded effective rate WAD greater than or equal to this value.

effective_rate_wad_lte.description: Filter for compounded effective rate WAD less than or equal to this value.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

listed.description: Filter by market listing status. When true, returns only positions on listed markets; when false, only positions on unlisted markets. Omit to return both.

loan_assets.description: Filter by loan token addresses. Combine with chain_ids; lowercase input is checksummed.

market_family_ids.description: Filter by Midnight market family ids. Combined with market_ids using AND semantics.

maturities.description: Filter by exact maturity timestamps, in unix seconds.

maturity_gte.description: Filter for maturities greater than or equal to this unix timestamp.

maturity_lte.description: Filter for maturities less than or equal to this unix timestamp.

pending_fee_gte.description: Filter for pending fee greater than or equal to this value.

pending_fee_lte.description: Filter for pending fee less than or equal to this value.

user-address.description: User address to list positions for. Lowercase input is checksummed.

name: morpho_midnight_list_user_positions

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there is none.

chain_id.description: Chain id where the position exists.

cost_basis.description: Cost basis in loan-token units, WAD-scaled, when available.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the user first acquired a position in this market, in unix seconds.

effective_apr.description: Annualized simple effective rate using a 365-day year, as a decimal fraction capped at 10, derived from persisted open lots when available.

effective_rate_wad.description: Annualized compounded effective rate (IRR+) using a 365.25-day year, WAD-scaled, when available.

last_loss_factor.description: Loss factor last applied to this position.
